messages:
Maria (AM): starting FinTrust POC thread. They need Private deploy in their AWS account, deterministic egress IPs for allowlisting, and a security questionnaire completed. Timeline: 2-week POC.
Alex (SE): main asks: preserve client source IP for downstream services; support mTLS to control plane. They want guidance: PrivateLink vs VPC Peering.
Raj (NetOps): recommendation: PrivateLink (interface endpoints) preferred for cross-account stability and avoiding route-table exposure. Peering ok if no overlapping CIDRs but harder to manage.
Maria (AM): two security blockers: 1) unknown/rotating egress IPs, 2) exact firewall rules to our control plane.
Tim (Solutions Eng): two POC patterns: Minimal: reuse customer NAT (cheapest) -> SNAT (lose client IP). Full: deploy Redwood Private in their VPC behind NLBs + proxy-protocol v2 OR provision NAT Gateways with EIPs per AZ for stable egress.
Raj (NetOps): sample connectivity test for PrivateLink:
```
curl -v https://vpce-0abc123.vpce-svc-zzz.us-west-2.vpce.amazonaws.com/health -H 'Host: model.redwood-inference.com'
```
Alex (SE): note: if customer's TLS-inspection rewrites SNI, cert validation breaks. Recommend bypass for our hostnames or use mTLS.
Sophia (InfoSec): questionnaire language suggestion: "No public inbound ports required. Outbound: HTTPS (443) to control plane FQDNs (*.redwood-inference.com). TLS 1.2+ enforced. Customers may enforce egress via dedicated EIPs/NAT Gateways for allowlisting. Customer-managed KMS supported for Private deployments; key usage auditable via CloudTrail."
Maria (AM): pricing Q: will NAT/EIP options add POC cost?
Tim (Solutions Eng): yes. Offer Minimal (reuse NAT) vs Isolated (NAT Gateways + EIPs per AZ). We'll include ballpark NAT/EIP daily costs in the quote.
Raj (NetOps): caveat: avoid VPC Peering if overlapping CIDRs or complex spoke topologies; use PrivateLink or Transit Gateway instead.
Maria (AM): action items: Tim -> 1-page diagram + curl test (ETA today). Raj -> firewall rules & NAT/EIP pattern (ETA EOD). Sophia -> questionnaire attestation wording (ETA tomorrow). Alex -> KMS/legal note.
deploy-bot: POC sandbox infra ready in us-west-2 (build-982). :rocket:
Maria (AM): thanks team. I'll present to FinTrust tomorrow; please add any one-line clarifications.
Alex (SE): one-liner to add: "Control plane traffic uses TLS 1.2+ to public FQDNs; customers can enforce egress via dedicated EIPs for allowlisting."
Sophia (InfoSec): and: "Customer-managed KMS supported; key usage auditable via CloudTrail."
Maria (AM): closing loop, will attach diagram to their questionnaire.
